title: Test Result Analyzer fails if no stack trace is available
summary: Fixed Test Result Analyzer to handle XML elements without stack traces by using InnerText instead of the potentially null text property.
key_points: Switched from #Text to InnerText for XML element content retrieval
Prevents null reference errors when analyzing test results with empty stack traces
Ensures the analyzer handles edge cases in test failure reporting
Uses safer XML property access pattern
quote: TestResultAnalyzer uses "#Text", which might be null instead of InnerText
